from pathlib import Path

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h = len(out)
    if not h:
        return out
    w = len(out[0])
    # Bottom-row 5s mark columns to extend upward. Empty cells take the
    # nearest nonzero color below them; nonzero cells stay unchanged.
    for c in range(w):
        if out[h - 1][c] != 5:
            continue
        below = 5
        for r in range(h - 1, -1, -1):
            if out[r][c] != 0:
                below = out[r][c]
            else:
                out[r][c] = below
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p)
